info.title: terrain-viewer URL
info.description: Not an HTTP API: the viewer's URL. Every query parameter is state the app mirrors to the address bar (booleans, numbers, enums, lists) or an instruction read once on load. Lists are comma-separated unless marked repeatable.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: Instruction. A named preset from lib/projects.json: hidden panels, initial state, bundled sources.

parameters.name: terrainUrl
parameters.description: Instruction. View A's terrain as a URL, registered under a fixed id (older form of terrainSourceA=https://…).

parameters.name: basemapUrl
parameters.description: Instruction. View A's basemap as a URL (older form of basemapSource=https://…).

parameters.name: terrainType
parameters.description: Instruction. Type of URL terrain sources (cog, terrarium, terrainrgb, wms-raw, tilejson …) instead of the {z} guess.

parameters.name: basemapType
parameters.description: Instruction. Type of URL basemap sources (cog, tms, wms, wmts, tilejson) instead of the {z} guess.

parameters.name: viaTitiler
parameters.description: Instruction. Route URL COGs through titiler (files not in Web Mercator).

parameters.name: addSources
parameters.description: Instruction. Library entries (by id) made available in the BYOD lists without being selected.

parameters.name: addTerrainUrl
parameters.description: Instruction. URL terrain sources made available without being selected (repeat the parameter).

parameters.name: addBasemapUrl
parameters.description: Instruction. URL basemaps made available without being selected (repeat the parameter).

parameters.name: addOverlayUrl
parameters.description: Instruction. URL overlays made available; overlayBasemapIds (state) turns overlays on.

parameters.name: openSections
parameters.description: Instruction. Sidebar sections expanded on load (general, terrainSource, hillshade, drawing …).

parameters.name: closeSections
parameters.description: Instruction. Sidebar sections collapsed on load.

parameters.name: scrollTo
parameters.description: Instruction. Section key (or element id) the side panel opens and scrolls to.

parameters.name: bookmarksGallery
parameters.description: Instruction. Opens the Bookmarks gallery modal on arrival.

parameters.name: openLibrary
parameters.description: Instruction. terrain | basemap - opens that Library modal (the curated dataset list) on arrival.

parameters.name: bookmarksUrl
parameters.description: Instruction. A bookmarks JSON (the Bookmarks section's export format) fetched and merged into the visitor's bookmarks; pair with openSections=bookmarks.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: State. Embed/project convenience params: `project` looks up a named preset in lib/projects.json (see lib/project-config.ts); terrainUrl/basemapUrl let an embedder point straight at a raw tile/COG URL withou…

parameters.name: terrainType
parameters.description: State. Explicit source type for terrainUrl/basemapUrl when it's a raw URL (not an existing source id) — type can't always be inferred from the URL shape alone (e.g.

parameters.name: appMode
parameters.description: State. Which sidebar layout the ModePicker (TerrainControlPanel.tsx) shows — "historical" strips it down to just basemap browsing.

parameters.name: splitStyle
parameters.description: State. Master split control — replaces the old plain splitScreen boolean.

parameters.name: gridLayout
parameters.description: State. Only meaningful once splitStyle !== "off"; "overlay" always behaves as "2x1" regardless of this value (see the splitContainer render below).

parameters.name: splitBlendMode
parameters.description: State. "overlay"-only: pane B's CSS mix-blend-mode + opacity against pane A.

parameters.name: splitBlendModeEnabled
parameters.description: State. Lets a picked blend mode be toggled off (falls back to plain "normal") without losing/resetting it — a quick way to flip back and forth between a blended and a plain overlay comparison for the same p…

parameters.name: splitRatio
parameters.description: State. Split gutter position (overlay clip boundary / side-by-side divider) as a 0-1 ratio of the available width.

parameters.name: matchColorsToA
parameters.description: State. "overlay"-only: "Match Colors (View A as reference)" — live-samples both panes' CURRENTLY RENDERED canvases (whatever tiles are actually loaded in the viewport, re-sampled at most once/second) and re…

parameters.name: matchColorsColorSpace
parameters.description: State. Which color space the matching above is computed/applied in — "rgb" (default) is a live CSS filter; the others are a real per-pixel JS conversion, capped to a low working resolution (see HistogramMat…

parameters.name: showCaptureDatePill
parameters.description: State. Compare and Blend's "Show Capture Date" toggle — a small per-view pill for whichever views are actually on a dated historical source.

parameters.name: terrainSourceC
parameters.description: State. C-H only ever matter for gridLayout "2x2"/"3x1"/"3x2"/"4x1"/"4x2" — same shape as sourceA/B, just extra slots so bigger grids need no schema change.

parameters.name: overlayBasemapIds
parameters.description: State. 'overlay'-role custom basemap sources currently stacked on top of the active basemap (see basemap-byod-section.tsx's checkbox list) — shared across A/B, only meaningful in split-or-radio basemap mode…

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: State. The ONE scrubbed date (epoch ms) for whichever concrete historical source is active on this side (historicalActiveSource(A/B) below) — Wayback/HLS/GE-Historical/Planet/EOX-S2/Bing all share this sing…

parameters.name: historicalActiveSource
parameters.description: State. Which concrete underlying source (wayback/hls/ge-historical/planet/ eox-s2) actually renders when basemapSource(A/B) === "historical" — the sidebar only ever exposes one combined "Historical Imagery"…

parameters.name: timelineSources
parameters.description: State. Which historical sources' ticks are aggregated onto the shared timeline (pill toggles in historical-timeline-panel.tsx) — independent of which single source is actually "active"/rendered on the map.

parameters.name: timelineSourcesA
parameters.description: State. Per-side variants of timelineSources above — only meaningful when both basemapPerView AND splitStyle!=="off" are on (dualMode) AND the timeline's sync toggle is off, letting each active view aggregat…

parameters.name: historicalTimelineCollapsed
parameters.description: State. Whether the historical timeline's full bar (header + track) is collapsed down to just the small floating clock-icon toggle button.

parameters.name: coverageOverlays
parameters.description: State. Coverage footprints drawn on the map (Source Info -> Coverage overlays).

parameters.name: drawingUrl
parameters.description: State. Remote vector data in the Drawing tool, one layer per URL (comma- separated; nuqs encodes commas inside an item).

parameters.name: historicalControlsExpanded
parameters.description: State. Whether the timeline's title/source-pills/resolution-chips header row is shown (true) or the panel is in its minimal, track-only mode with just a small floating cog+collapse chip (false).

parameters.name: resolutionClasses
parameters.description: State. Resolution-class filter alongside the source pills above — "vhr" (Wayback/GE Historical/Bing, sub-meter-ish) vs "medium" (HLS's 10-30m Landsat/Sentinel-2, Planet's ~4.7m monthly mosaic) — see SOURCE_…

parameters.name: showHillshade
parameters.description: State. Native MapLibre Hillshade — its own independent viz mode, entirely separate from "Lighting Effects" (Matcap/Phong) below.

parameters.name: showLightingEffects
parameters.description: State. "Lighting Effects" viz mode — master toggle/opacity, housing two sub-modes: Matcap first, Phong second (see lighting-effects-options-section.tsx).

parameters.name: showMatcap
parameters.description: State. "Matcap" sub-mode (lib/matcap-protocol.ts) — a plain raster overlay (draped over 3D terrain the same automatic way the raster basemap is) that looks up color from a material-capture image using the s…

parameters.name: matcapRotationDeg
parameters.description: State. "Sphere Rotation" — spins the matcap lookup independently of the map's own bearing (a raster tile is baked once per z/x/y, so it can't track live bearing the way a real-time GPU shader could).

parameters.name: matcapRenderer
parameters.description: State. "raster" (default): lib/matcap-protocol.ts's plain raster-tile pipeline — drapes correctly over 3D terrain exaggeration AND globe, but every rotation/exaggeration change costs a real tile refetch.

parameters.name: matcapLightRelativeToCamera
parameters.description: State. "Light Anchor", ported from Phong's phongLightRelativeToCamera — only meaningful in "live" (2D Fast): off (Absolute) samples the material by the tile-space normal, pinned to compass directions and id…

parameters.name: showPhong
parameters.description: State. "Phong" sub-mode (lib/phong-protocol.ts) — a plain raster overlay doing real ambient+diffuse+specular shading from a compass-fixed light (state.illuminationDir/illuminationAlt below — the same fields…

parameters.name: phongLightRelativeToCamera
parameters.description: State. Off (default — briefly flipped to Camera on 2026-08-20, reverted the same day on the user's follow-up): illuminationDir is a compass azimuth, fixed to the world, matching maplibre's own hillshade ill…

parameters.name: phongRenderer
parameters.description: State. "raster" (default): lib/phong-protocol.ts's plain raster-tile pipeline — drapes correctly over 3D terrain exaggeration AND globe, but every light/strength/exaggeration change costs a real tile refetc…

parameters.name: showShadows
parameters.description: State. "Shadows" sub-mode (lib/shadow-protocol.ts) — a plain binary raster mask: for each pixel, marches toward the sun's actual azimuth (state.illuminationDir/illuminationAlt below — same shared light as H…

parameters.name: shadowRadiusPx
parameters.description: State. "Search Radius" — same convention as SVF/Openness: how many same-zoom pixels the single ray marches outward looking for an obstruction.

parameters.name: lightUseDatetime
parameters.description: State. "Datetime-based" light: when on, illuminationDir/illuminationAlt are driven from a physically-plausible sun position (see lib/solar-position.ts) computed from the viewport-center lat/lng + these day-…

parameters.name: lightTimeMode
parameters.description: State. Which clock convention lightTimeOfDay is expressed in — "local": the real civil wall-clock time at the viewport lat/lng, including that location's actual DST rules (see lib/timezone.ts); "utc": UTC d…

parameters.name: showTerrainAnalysis
parameters.description: State. Master toggles for what used to be one merged "Slope and More" viz mode, now split into Terrain Analysis (surface derivatives + neighborhood statistics: Slope/Aspect/Curvature/Det Hessian/Blobness/TP…

parameters.name: terrainAnalysisOpacity
parameters.description: State. Master opacity for Terrain Analysis — composites (multiplies) with each sub-mode's own opacity below, rather than replacing it.

parameters.name: slopeCustomStops
parameters.description: State. Only read when slopeColorRamp === "custom" — see computeColorReliefPaint's dedicated branch for that ramp id in MapLayers.tsx.

parameters.name: slopeCustomStopsDiscrete
parameters.description: State. When the custom ramp is selected, render its stops as hard discrete bands (each color holds until the next stop) instead of a continuous gradient.

parameters.name: showLocalDominance
parameters.description: State. Local Dominance (Hesse 2016) — Relief Visualization mode, see lib/local-dominance-protocol.ts.

parameters.name: showPlaneSlicer
parameters.description: State. Plane Slicer — Tools: Elevation Picker sub-section.

parameters.name: planeSlicerValue
parameters.description: State. Absolute and LRM keep independent threshold values — the two reference frames have wildly different natural ranges (metres of real elevation vs.

parameters.name: elevationPickerReferenceMode
parameters.description: State. Same Absolute/LRM reference as Plane Slicer, for the Elevation Picker's point/profile sampling itself (lib/elevation-query.ts) — "LRM" here has no 3D-mesh equivalent (map.queryTerrainElevation() only…

parameters.name: tellsBeta
parameters.description: State. Experimental — opt-in via Settings (or ?tellsBeta=true directly) so it doesn't clutter Visualization Modes for everyone by default.

parameters.name: sunShadowBeta
parameters.description: State. Same opt-in-beta gate as tellsBeta above, for Tools: Sun Shadow Calculator.

parameters.name: historicalBeta
parameters.description: State. Same opt-in-beta gate as tellsBeta above, for the historical-imagery basemaps (Wayback/HLS/GE Historical/Planet) + bottom timeline panel.

parameters.name: showTellsDetector
parameters.description: State. Master on/off (Visualization Modes' "Tells (Mound Detector)" checkbox) — gates the sidebar's Mound Candidates section as well as the map layer.

parameters.name: tellsMarkersVisible
parameters.description: State. Mound Candidates section's own "Show mound candidates" checkbox — a pure paint-visibility toggle for markers already being computed, independent of showTellsDetector so it can't also collapse the sec…

parameters.name: tellsScaleMarkers
parameters.description: State. Only meaningful with tellMeasureScale on: draw each marker at tellsScaleMultiplier x its measured diameter (real-world meters, zoom-scaled) instead of fixed px.

parameters.name: tellsPolarity
parameters.description: State. Which extrema the detector reports: mounds (local maxima of the relief, the archaeological tell), pits (minima: quarries, sinkholes, craters, cisterns, robbed-out tombs) or both.

parameters.name: tellsFrozen
parameters.description: State. "Frozen" pins the currently-computed candidates in place (snapshotted into a plain geojson source, see the tellsFrozenSnapshot state and TellsSource's frozen/frozenSnapshot props below) so panning/zo…

parameters.name: matchThemeColors
parameters.description: State. Sky/horizon/fog colors for the Background + Fog/Sky mode (background- options-section.tsx) — URL-shareable state like every other viz-mode field, not a localStorage preference (was previously a plain…

parameters.name: rasterBasemapOpacity
parameters.description: State. Viz-mode master opacity (the "Raster Basemap" checkbox's own slider) — composites (multiplies) with basemapSourceOpacity below for the single/split basemap layer, same pattern as Slope-and-More's mas…

parameters.name: basemapSourceOpacity
parameters.description: State. Basemap-solo opacity (the "Basemap Opacity" slider inside the Basemap Source section) — only affects the single/split basemap layer, not overlays.

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: State. Whole-earth start, the same view handleGoHome resets to and historical mode already used.

parameters.name: pitch
parameters.description: State. -- try getting out of pitch 0 loop in 3d pitch: parseAsFloat.withDefault(60.001),

parameters.name: shadowColor
parameters.description: State. shadowColor: parseAsString.withDefault("#000000"), highlightColor: parseAsString.withDefault("#FFFFFF"), accentColor: parseAsString.withDefault("#808080"),

parameters.name: hillshadeExag
parameters.description: State. graticuleColor: parseAsString.withDefault("#000"), graticuleColor: parseAsString, // don't use default to sync with theme

parameters.name: contourReferenceMode
parameters.description: State. Absolute ("real altitude") vs LRM ("height above/below the local neighborhood mean") — same reference concept Plane Slicer introduced (PLANE_SLICER_REFERENCE_MODES above), applied to what the contour…

parameters.name: contourMinorLrm
parameters.description: State. Absolute and LRM keep independent interval values, same reasoning as planeSlicerValue/planeSlicerValueLrm — LRM's natural range (roughly ±100m of local relief) is much narrower than real elevation's,…

parameters.name: contourWeight
parameters.description: State. Multiplies both major and minor contour line-width — default (1) keeps today's major-vs-minor ratio, 2/4 make both proportionally bolder.

parameters.name: contourColor
parameters.description: State. Contour line / graticule colors — empty string means "auto" (theme-adaptive: the contour lines fall back to translucent black/white by theme, the grid to themeAntiColor).

parameters.name: hypsoSymmetric
parameters.description: State. Min/Max mirrored around 0 (one magnitude), like the curvature ramp: for height-above-ground or elevation-change grids (DSM − DTM, dh).

parameters.name: invertColorRamp
parameters.description: State. Keyframe/360 animation state (animDuration, animLoopMode, animSmoothCamera, animPlaying, animPlaying360, animPose1, animPose2Delta) lives in its own nuqs hook inside CameraUtilities.tsx, not in this …

parameters.name: maxBoundsMode
parameters.description: State. Max map bounds (Settings > Map Bounds) — constrains pan/zoom rather than a one-shot camera fly like the smart-zoom/fit-to-bounds features above.
